plain: A solemn, binding agreement or promise

webster.text: A mutual consent or agreement of two or more persons, to do or to forbear some act or thing; a contract; stipulation.

example.quote: The body-politic is formed by a voluntary association of individuals: It is a social compact, by which the whole people covenants with each citizen, and each citizen with the whole people, that all shall be governed by certain laws for the common good.
